hero.badge: ✨ Best Rated Dental Clinic in Lahore
hero.headline: Your Smile, Our Priority
hero.subheadline: Experience gentle, pain-free dental care backed by cutting-edge technology and Pakistan's first AI dental assistant. From routine checkups to complete smile transformations.

services.title: World-Class Dental Services
services.subtitle: Combining gentle patient care with state-of-the-art German and Japanese clinical technology.

checkup.title: General Checkup & Consultation
checkup.description: Digital HD X-rays, comprehensive oral cancer screening, and detailed personalized treatment planning.

scaling.title: Scaling & Ultrasonic Polishing
scaling.description: Deep ultrasonic plaque and tartar removal with stain polishing for healthier gums and fresher breath.

rootCanal.title: Single-Visit Root Canal (RCT)
rootCanal.description: Painless rotary endodontic therapy with digital apex locator to save your natural tooth in one comfortable session.

braces.title: Braces & Invisible Aligners
braces.description: Custom clear aligners and ceramic/metal braces to straighten crooked teeth discreetly for teens and adults.

implants.title: Permanent Dental Implants
implants.description: Titanium bio-compatible root replacements providing permanent, natural-looking teeth with lifetime durability.

whitening.title: Laser Teeth Whitening
whitening.description: Instant 6 to 8 shades brighter smile in a single 45-minute clinic session with zero enamel damage.

kids.title: Pediatric & Kids Dentistry
kids.description: Friendly, fun, and fear-free dental visits for children. Cavity fluoride varnishes, fillings, and gentle habits coaching.

emergency.title: 24/7 Dental Emergency Care
emergency.description: Immediate relief for severe toothaches, chipped/broken teeth, lost fillings, bleeding gums, and facial trauma.

whyUs.title: Why Lahore Trusts Us With Their Smiles
whyUs.subtitle: We believe visiting the dentist should be stress-free, transparent, and pain-free.

experienced.title: Experienced Dentists
experienced.description: Over 14+ years of clinical excellence led by PMDC certified specialists with UK & European training.

modern.title: Modern Digital Equipment
modern.description: Equipped with low-radiation digital sensors, rotary endodontics, intraoral 4K cameras, and Class-B autoclaves.

painless.title: Painless Treatment
painless.description: Computerized local anesthesia and gentle techniques designed especially for anxious and sensitive patients.

affordable.title: Affordable & Transparent
affordable.description: Clear pricing with no hidden charges. Flexible payment plans available for aligners and implant treatments.

doctor.name: Dr. Sarah Tariq Khan
doctor.qualifications: BDS, RDS, C-Implants (UK), M.Sc Oral Surgery (Cert.)
doctor.bio: Dr. Sarah Tariq is one of Lahore's most respected restorative and aesthetic dentists. With extensive training in minimally invasive dentistry, she has restored over 8,000 happy smiles with a warm, empathetic touch.

gallery.title: Real Patient Results & Modern Clinic
gallery.subtitle: Take a look at our clinical environment, high sterilization protocols, and before/after smile transformations.

testimonials.title: What Our Patients Say
testimonials.subtitle: Real experiences from families and professionals across Lahore.

items.name: Hamza Rafiq
items.text: I was terrified of getting an implant, but Dr. Sarah and her team made it completely painless. From the AI booking to the final crown, everything was seamless!

items.name: Ayesha Bilal
items.text: Got my teeth whitened for my brother's wedding. Results were instantaneous and my teeth didn't hurt at all. Best dental clinic in Gulberg by far.

items.name: Omer Cheema
items.text: Had severe throbbing pain on a Friday evening. Used their website AI chat, got booked immediately, and the root canal was completed painlessly in one sitting.

items.name: Zainab Malik
items.text: Halfway through my aligner treatment and my smile is already transformed. Very transparent pricing with monthly installments. Highly recommended!
